title: Mixed Botanical Embroidered Dress
description: A refined A-line knit dress in navy with delicate embroidery that brings a quiet luxuriance to the clean silhouette. The wool-blend fabric provides both comfort and a polished, structured drape.

title: Mixed Botanical Printed O Pochette
description: The O Pochette is rendered in a mixed botanical printed Saffiano leather, the season's signature floral print brought to the compact crossbody form with a refined, considered touch. An interior pocket and push-lock closure offer quiet practicality.

title: Crystal Pavé Knot Minaudière
description:
This clutch showcases a clasp intricately knotted into a fluid, sculptural design, subtly evoking the interlocking Oscar 'O' emblem in an abstract form. The clutch’s satin base is encrusted with pavé crystals, while a detachable chain strap allows it to be worn hands-free or carried as a statement piece.
Care Note: The signature knot is an ornamental accent that highlights the artistry of the Minaudière. To preserve its form, open the bag using the magnetic top frame and avoid applying pressure to the knot.
Materials: 60% Lambskin, 30% Glass, 10% Brass.
Care: Take extra care when handling, as prongs on stones can catch on fabrics and may cause damage to woven clothing. Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight to prevent discoloration of fabrics or embellishments. Keep away from heat sources to prevent damage to beading and embellishments. Store in its original packaging, protected from light, heat, cold, and humidity. Due to the delicate nature of the material, specialized cleaning is recommended.…

title: The Alibi in Wicker
description: A fresh evolution of the iconic silhouette, the Alibi handbag is reimagined in hand-woven wicker. The structured design is accented with the House's signature floral appliqué and finished with a polished chain strap for versatile wear.

title: Crystal Drop Earrings
description: A single faceted crystal drop hangs from a polished brass post in violet, offering a minimal yet luminous post-back earring with a clean, jewel-like presence. A refined and versatile everyday piece.

title: Embossed Mini TRO Bag
description: The house's signature Mini TRO silhouette is rendered in richly textured embossed calfskin, the structured crossbody form offering a refined versatility suited to any occasion. A push-lock closure and chain strap complete the polished, compact design.

title: Mixed Botanical Silk Twill Pant
description: The season's mixed botanical print in blue multi is rendered in silk twill for a fluid pant that moves beautifully. The print brings an exuberant painterly quality to the most refined of wardrobe staples.

title: Dominican Mixed-Floral Guipure High-Low Dress
description: This cocktail dress is crafted from intricate Dominican mixed-floral guipure, where vibrant blooms and lush foliage form a richly dimensional lace. The sculpted bodice is framed by delicate floral straps, while the voluminous skirt creates a playful silhouette. Sleeveless, sweetheart neckline, asymmetrical hemline, concealed back zipper. 100% Polyamide; Lining: 100% Silk. Spot clean only. Do not dry clean, iron, steam, bleach, or wash.

title: Dominican Mixed-Floral Wide Leg Pant
description: Crafted from silk twill, these wide-leg pants feature the Dominican Mixed-Floral print, bringing a vibrant, painterly expression to the silhouette. The elastic waistband offers a relaxed, comfortable fit, balancing ease with fluid movement.

title: Knot Clutch
description: This clutch showcases a clasp intricately knotted into a fluid, sculptural design, subtly evoking the interlocking Oscar 'O' emblem in an abstract form. The clutch's sleek sheen enhances its refined presence, while a removable shoulder strap adds versatility, allowing it to be worn hands-free or carried as a statement piece.

title: Chiné Dominican Mixed-Floral Chiffon Sweetheart Gown
description: A vibrant array of Dominican florals unfolds across this silk chiffon gown, rendered in a Chiné print inspired by the traditional weaving technique. Long sleeves with button cuffs, off shoulder, sweetheart neckline, floor-sweeping hemline with short train, concealed back zipper. 100% Silk, 100% Polyamide. Dry clean only.

title: Embroidered Column Gown
description: A tapestry of crystal blossoms envelops this strapless gown, each hand-applied petal shimmering with luminous depth. Framed by floral straps and a scalloped hem, this sculpted silhouette is transformed into a true work of couture.

title: Mixed Botanical Off-Shoulder Dress
description: Off-shoulder midi dress in mixed botanical print with a twisted, folded neckline. Fitted bodice with a full, gathered skirt. 100% Cotton. Machine wash cold, do not bleach, tumble dry low, iron on low heat if needed.

title: Mixed Botanical Tie-Neck Cardigan
description: Part of the season's coordinated twinset, this all-over floral cardigan pairs beautifully with its matching tank. The cotton-viscose blend provides a fluid hand with just enough structure.

title: Maple Leaves Faille Dress
description: Sleeveless scoop-neck cocktail dress in green-multi maple leaf print faille.

title: O Satin Minaudière
description:
This timeless handbag captivates with its sleek, structured silhouette. Wrapped in luxurious satin, it's finished with Oscar de la Renta's iconic 'O' emblem and resin cabochon at the clasp—a nod to the House's storied heritage. With a gold-tone detachable chain link shoulder strap, this piece effortlessly transitions into a clutch.
Materials: 90% Satin, 10% Brass.
Care: Remove dust regularly with a dry cloth. Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight to prevent fabric discoloration. Keep away from heat sources to preserve the bag's integrity. Store in its original packaging in a cool, dry place, protected from light, heat, and humidity. Due to the delicate nature of the material, specialized cleaning is recommended. Please consult a specialist at Oscar de la Renta.

title: Mixed Botanical Cropped Jacket
description: A collared knit jacket in a refined navy wool-blend, with delicate embroidery that adds an artful dimension to the structured knit surface. A versatile layering piece that bridges tailoring and knitwear with ease. Long sleeves, collared neckline, unlined. Country of Origin: Italy. Style Code: 26FE187NEW_NAV. 97% Wool, 2% Polyamide, 1% Elastane. Dry clean only. Do not wash, bleach, iron, steam, or tumble dry.

title: Mixed Botanical Tie-Detailed Blouse
description: A garden in full bloom rendered in lightweight cotton voile, this blouse captures the season's botanical spirit with an all-over mixed floral print. A delicate tie detail at the neckline lends an effortlessly refined finish.

title: Chiné Palm Leaves Jacket
description: Long Sleeves, Shoulder Pads, Open Front, Front Flap Pockets. 100% Polyester; Lining: 100% Silk. Dry clean only. Style Code: 26PN509LCV_EIV. Country of Origin: Italy.

title: Butterfly Embroidered O Minaudière
description:
Delicate butterfly and floral motifs unfold across this O Minaudière in intricate embroidery, creating a luminous tapestry of texture and shine. The structured silhouette is accented with Oscar de la Renta's iconic 'O' emblem and resin cabochon at the clasp.
Materials: 100% Satin.
Care: Take extra care when handling, as prongs on stones can catch on fabrics and may cause damage to woven clothing. Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight to prevent discoloration of fabrics or embellishments. Keep away from heat sources to prevent damage to beading and embellishments. Store in its original packaging, protected from light, heat, cold, and humidity. Due to the delicate nature of the material, specialized cleaning is recommended. Please consult a specialist at Oscar de la Renta.

title: Turtleneck Wool Short-Sleeve Pullover
description: A fold-over turtleneck in pure wool defines this short-sleeve pullover, creating a graceful, layered neckline that brings a modern sensibility to a classic silhouette. Short sleeves; fold-over turtleneck; unlined. 100% wool. Dry clean only. Made in Italy.

title: Chrysanthemum Earrings
description: The chrysanthemum motif is rendered in a layered brass form with a single plastic pearl center, offering a considered, floral stud with a delicate, hand-finished quality. A versatile and quietly refined everyday piece. Country of Origin: Italy.

title: Pearl Nest Cuff Bracelet
description: Polished metal strands intertwine to form a sculptural cuff, dotted with luminous pearls that appear delicately suspended throughout the design. The layered silhouette wraps the wrist in fluid movement and dimension.

title: Beaded Floral Embroidered Pencil Dress
description: Beaded floral embroidery is worked across the surface of this short-sleeve stretch wool cocktail dress, each bloom adding a luminous, celebratory dimension. The ivory colorway renders the embellishment in full relief.

title: Ombré Crewneck Pullover
description: A painterly print covers this crew-neck wool pullover in a pink and brown palette, bringing the season's botanical spirit to the knitwear category. The fine wool base provides warmth and a refined, polished hand.

title: Crystal Fringe Chandelier Earrings
description:
A faceted crystal stud anchors cascading strands of shimmering rhinestones, creating a dramatic chandelier silhouette. The polished setting is dotted with scattered crystals that amplify the sparkle from every angle.

Materials: 75% Brass, 15% Glass.

Care: Avoid harsh chemicals, lotions, and perfumes. Do not wear in pool/shower. Wipe with a damp microfiber cloth and store separately in a cloth pouch.

title: Mixed Botanical Midi Skirt
description: The season's mixed botanical print in brown multi is cut into a full circle skirt in stretch cotton, the sweep of the hem allowing the vibrant print to move beautifully. A versatile, celebratory piece that pairs effortlessly with the season's knits. Circle skirt silhouette, unlined. Country of Origin: Italy. Style Code: 26FN4042MCK_BRU. 97% Cotton, 3% Elastane. Machine wash cold, do not bleach, tumble dry low, iron on low heat if needed.

title: Printed Twinset Cardigan
description: A printed twinset cardigan in blue sheer, the all-over print bringing a painterly, seasonal spirit to the classic cardigan form. The cotton-viscose blend provides a fluid, comfortable hand.

title: Wool Wide-Leg Pant
description: The season's indigo wool drill tailoring is cut into a refined straight-leg trouser with clean, precise lines. A wardrobe foundation that pairs seamlessly with the coordinating tailored separates.

title: Ombré Feather Embroidered Silk Chiffon Gown
description: A study in weightless romance, this strapless gown is cut from finely pleated silk chiffon that deepens from pale blush at the sweetheart bodice to a sun-warmed rose at the hem. Hand-draped pleating gathers into a softly knotted center front, releasing into a fluid empire-waist column, while rows of ostrich feather embroidery bloom through the lower skirt for movement that catches the slightest turn.

title: Palm Leaves Metallic Cocktail Dress
description: Palm leaves are sculpted in metallic embroidery across this cocktail dress, creating a striking, dimensional effect. The strapless silhouette is defined by layered, textural movement, with each element adding depth and fluidity.

title: O Knot Bracelet
description: Featuring gold-tone links reminiscent of the Oscar 'O' emblem, this knotted design weaves together smooth and textured metal for a captivating look. The unique setting adds depth and dimension, beautifully contrasting with the silver circle links.

title: Printed Twinset Tank
description: The coordinating printed twinset tank in blue sheer, pairing seamlessly with the matching cardigan. The cotton-viscose blend offers a comfortable, fluid hand and a beautifully layered seasonal look.

title: Chiné Hibiscus Threadwork Cropped Cardigan
description: Chiné hibiscus threadwork brings soft dimension to this refined cardigan, complemented by intricate guipure lace trim that defines the silhouette with delicate texture. Pair with its coordinating dress for an artistic statement.

title: Iris Printed Saffiano O Pochette
description:
The O Pochette is rendered in a printed Saffiano calfskin featuring the season's iris motif, the structured crossbody form providing a refined versatility suited to any occasion. The push-lock closure and chain strap complete the polished, compact design.
Materials: 100% Calf Leather.
Care: Remove dust regularly with a dry or slightly damp cloth and allow to dry completely. Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight to prevent discoloration. Keep away from heat sources to prevent the leather from drying out or becoming rigid. Store in its original packaging in a cool, dry place, protected from light, heat, and humidity. For oil stains, gently wash with water and mild soap. If needed, test a degreasing agent on a hidden area before applying.

title: Faded Mixed Botanical Denim Pant
description: The season's faded mixed botanical print is applied to cotton denim for a relaxed pant with a distinctive, artisanal aesthetic. The washed treatment lends the botanical motifs a painterly, sun-faded quality.

title: Dominican Landscape Oversized Pullover
description: The Dominican Landscape print brings a painterly expression of place to this oversized pullover, nodding to Oscar de la Renta’s heritage and roots in the Dominican Republic. Long sleeves, crew neckline, oversized silhouette, ribbed trim, pullover style. 100% Virgin Wool. Dry clean only.

title: Mixed Botanical Scarf
description: The season's mixed botanical flower print is rendered in a generous modal-cashmere scarf, offering a luxuriously soft and lightweight way to carry the collection's signature florals. The oversized 140x190cm format allows for versatile styling.

title: Mixed Botanical Embroidered Georgette Caftan
description: Sumptuous georgette serves as the canvas for an all-over beaded flower embroidery, with each bloom meticulously hand-applied. Long sleeves complete the ethereal, romantic silhouette.

title: Hibiscus Embroidered Knit Pullover
description: Delicate hibiscus embroidery blooms across this refined knit pullover, adding dimensional texture to the clean silhouette. The softly structured shape is framed by a high neckline and ribbed trims for a polished finish.

title: Sequin Cascade Earrings
description:
Sequins and mixed beads are layered in a cascading formation, the shimmering surface catching the light with a vibrant, celebratory brilliance. The handcrafted construction gives each pair a unique, artisanal quality.
Materials: 40% PVC, 20% Crystal Glass, 20% Acrylic, 10% Polyester, 5% Georgette, 5% Brass.
Care: Avoid exposing your jewelry to harsh chemicals. Lotions, cosmetics, hairspray and perfumes can cause chemical reactions that can cause the finish to deteriorate. Before handling, washing hands after applying makeup and hair products will help to preserve the finish. Do not wear in the pool, on the beach or in the shower. Wipe away dirt and body oils with a slightly damp microfiber jewelry cloth or cotton ball and allow to dry.

title: Dominican Landscape Pencil Skirt
description: The Dominican Landscape print brings a painterly expression of place to this pencil skirt, nodding to Oscar de la Renta’s heritage and roots in the Dominican Republic. Sweeping palm trees and beach scenes unfold across the silhouette, capturing the warmth and vibrancy of the island.

title: Knot Clutch
description: This clutch showcases a clasp intricately knotted into a fluid, sculptural design, subtly evoking the interlocking Oscar 'O' emblem in an abstract form. The clutch's sleek sheen enhances its refined presence, while a removable shoulder strap adds versatility, allowing it to be worn hands-free or carried as a statement piece. Dimensions: 32 cm x 13 cm x 10 cm. Weight: 393 grams. Chain drop length 20 cm. Interior pocket, lift-up closure, detachable shoulder strap, blush nappa leather interior. Style Code: 00NH187CLF_BLK. Country of Origin: Italy. 100% Calf Leather (Saffiano embossed grain).

title: Mixed Botanical Scarf
description:
The season's mixed botanical flower print is rendered in a generous modal-cashmere scarf, offering a luxuriously soft and lightweight way to carry the collection's signature florals. The oversized 140×190cm format allows for versatile styling.
Materials: 90% Modal, 10% Cashmere.
Care: Dry clean only. Do not wash, bleach, tumble dry, iron, or steam.

title: Wildflower Drop Clip-On Earrings
description:
Three wildflower blooms are suspended at varying lengths in a triple drop formation, the peach tones giving the earring a soft, garden-fresh quality. A charming, feminine piece with a delicate, natural movement.
Care: Avoid exposing your jewelry to harsh chemicals. Lotions, cosmetics, hairspray and perfumes can cause chemical reactions that can cause the finish to deteriorate. Before handling, washing hands after applying makeup and hair products will help to preserve the finish. Do not wear in the pool, on the beach or in the shower. Wipe away dirt and body oils with a slightly damp microfiber jewelry cloth or cotton ball and allow to dry.

title: The Topaz
description:
The Dominican Landscape print brings a painterly expression of place to this tote, nodding to Oscar de la Renta’s heritage and roots in the Dominican Republic. Crafted from full-grain Taurillon leather with a natural pebbled finish, the spacious silhouette is detailed with the signature "O" at the clasp.
A special-edition anniversary embossing commemorates the House’s 60th year—a detail that rewards a closer look.
Materials: 100% Bull Leather.
Care: Remove dust regularly with a dry or slightly damp cloth and allow to dry completely. Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight to prevent fabric discoloration. Keep away from heat sources to prevent the leather from drying out or becoming rigid. Store in its original packaging, in a cool, dry place, away from light, heat, and humidity. For oil stains, gently wash with water and mild soap. If needed, test a degreasing agent on a hidden area before applying.

title: Metallic Beaded Tassel Clip-On Earrings
description:
A long column of metallic glass beads tapers into a dramatic tassel, the navy or pink palette lending a refined, jewel-toned depth. Each earring is handcrafted, making every pair a subtly individual creation.

Materials: 50% Crystal Glass, 25% Polyester Thread, 15% Brass, 10% Cotton.

Care: Avoid harsh chemicals, lotions, and perfumes. Do not wear in pool/shower. Wipe with a damp microfiber cloth and store separately in a cloth pouch.

title: Mixed Botanical Embroidered Oversized Pullover
description: A large-scale floral intarsia pattern is worked entirely by hand into this luxurious wool-cotton pullover, each bloom rendered with the precision of a painting. A singular piece that carries the craft and artistry of the house.

title: The Mini Poppy
description:
The Dominican Landscape print brings a painterly expression of place to this compact handbag, nodding to Oscar de la Renta’s heritage and roots in the Dominican Republic. Crafted from full-grain Taurillon leather with a natural pebbled finish, this petite silhouette balances sophistication with practicality, featuring a top handle and removable shoulder strap. A special-edition anniversary embossing commemorates the House’s 60th year.

Materials: 100% Bull Leather.

Care: Remove dust with a dry or slightly damp cloth. Avoid prolonged sun exposure and heat sources. Store in original packaging in a cool, dry place. For stains, wipe with lukewarm water or mild soapy water.
